headline: Instagram users: Here’s how to stop Meta’s AI from using your photos
context: Muse Image allows users to generate AI images using photos from public Instagram accounts. As long as a person's profile is public, another user can tag that account and use their images as part of an AI-generated creation.

sources.name: TechCrunch
